name: ATM BlindBox predictable expired-blockhash settlement
summary: BlindBox bets resolve on blockhash(betBlock+2), but settle(betId) is public and caller-timed and lastUnsettledId auto-settles only one bet per entry. Once that blockhash expires, _trySettle falls back to keccak256(block.prevrandao, betId, block.timestamp), which the settler knows in advance. The attacker queued 1-ATM filler bets to block auto-settlement, settled winners at once and settled losers after expiry in blocks where the fallback made them win, draining the DEAD-address payout pool at 1.95x.

loss.notes: Net depletion of the BlindBox payout pool (ATM held by 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD) to attacker helper 0x9c1819640201f223596fad4f6401900b4b732eea from the anchor block through the last winning settlement: payouts minus the helper's own stakes, which are attacker-supplied inputs. The helper's 7 real-blockhash wins before the anchor (net 1118951.4125 ATM) did not execute the fallback and are excluded; including them would give 57959313.6 ATM, 98131.66 USD. ATM is valued at the attacker's realised disposal rate: the helper sold all 58064313.6 ATM it held into the PancakeSwap V2 ATM/USDT pair for 98309.438441108095465392 BSC-USD. That selling crushed the price (the PoC-implied pre-sale rate was about 0.0076 USD/ATM). BSC-USD is at par. The project's cold wallet later moved the remaining DEAD balance in claimFromBlackhole 0xc38d12f78d84732d3d5377e3b489cab13daa11f4a1e5fa28c09c4f94075de610 (block 87530672); that is not netted.

ageReset.description: The immutable BlindBox runtime contains both the caller-timed settle() and the predictable expired-blockhash fallback. The ATM token's blindBoxContract wiring (setSubContracts, block 87296867) is ordinary initial wiring to this address, and no erroneous value is needed for the defect, so deployment supplies the age.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. eth_getLogs on BlindBox 0x1f8336aef584795e282fece8de356babd7734c59, blocks 87295347..87700000: 5286 BetPlaced (topic0 0x1b8a9031cb9351278d70a994f81536e9e08c91162e64f92b2fe4766fb7a891b4) and 5266 BetSettled (topic0 0xe730d6310bec1dfc964bdf1e3f75a78c8ef2dee9d092f9ff09253258852ed7d4); none after block 87530623. A settlement took the fallback when its (placement block + 2) was more than 256 blocks old and it was the first settlement of that target block, so cachedBlockHash was empty; 557 settlements qualify. Before the anchor, 455 fallback settlements all came from bet entry, where onBlindBoxEntry auto-settles lastUnsettledId: 448 ATM transfers to dEaD, 2 ERC-4337 handleOps whose smart account transfers ATM to dEaD, and 5 inside attacker bet-placing calls (selector 0x9cc4ed0a). They won 221 and lost 234, which is chance-level, and Etherscan V2 txlist shows no direct BlindBox call before block 90149619. The attacker EOA 0x3f9bd963641e969fc0c9ddf1c67e210e84915b7d deployed helper 0x9c1819640201f223596fad4f6401900b4b732eea (0x35d9fd468bd30369d9fe91b44397a5a07140310d1cadc898f95839a6ca2cd7f2, block 87513684). The helper's 0x9cc4ed0a queues up to 100 1-ATM filler bets plus one large even-parity bet; that call executes no DIFFICULTY at depth 1. Its settle wrapper 0x2bcc7ddd reads bets(id), then at depth 1 executes NUMBER, BLOCKHASH(target) and, when that returns zero, DIFFICULTY and TIMESTAMP (debug_traceTransaction structLogs, pcs 1883/1972/1984/1986) before calling BlindBox.settle. It did so in 82 successful txs. Its first seven calls (first 0x04ec2a49f3ff32dd0828bbaa7dcfe613d1b936ade781741a571dcad87ae8780d, block 87515760) settled large bets 10 to 148 blocks after target, on the live blockhash. Anchor source-1 is the first 0x2bcc7ddd call to execute the fallback: settle(0x140e) at block 87517587, tx index 10, target 87517013 (574 blocks old); BetSettled log 70 pays bettor 0x7aca6eeaec709e653f011f5aac9e5dba73e5b6d1 292.5 ATM, a predictor test. The first fallback win on the attacker's own bet is PoC tx 0xb74a572967ce997afa5920811e6a9dc8b82a6e41ee31fa4d1a24a85aec89e342 (block 87517892): settle(0x1410), target 818 blocks old, ATM log 3 pays 585000 ATM from dEaD. In total, 38 of the helper's 0x2bcc7ddd fallback settlements pay its own bets, the first being the PoC tx. Identity: eth_getCode is empty at block 87295346; keccak256 is 0xc0cabb4120336740866ab054e8458f3fa37e9c9207485f36f368a8a8e0c651ee at blocks 87295347, 87517586 and 87530623. Source-4 is a top-level creation by 0x6342bacf1839aeca00fbcced499125a2b946ec9c whose receipt contractAddress is the target. Source-5 has no owner, upgrade, selfdestruct or setter, and atmToken is immutable. ATM token 0x9c86f45905868317bacb8f442653d5e9a6888888 blindBoxContract() returns 0x0 at block 87296866 and the target from block 87296867 through 87517586. That value comes from cold-wallet 0x6df7c5a8b5a3a2b514e602c6126d883ad42d1352 setSubContracts calls 0x1bc86030be2c111d5a77881db0fe58515e2a5980ade0d5b5f4ff9aab72dd9be8 (block 87296867) and 0xdaed1941236262457f0bda4872d9031e8cccc9c89d04caf71d3d9639a5eb316b (block 87296930), both with the same (BlindBox, ExitQueue, Lottery) arguments. Ordinary wiring: no configuration value bears on the randomness defect.

Verified BlindBox standard-JSON source at https://bscscan.com/address/0x1f8336aef584795e282fece8de356babd7734c59#code; reproduce with Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode, chainid=56. ContractName BlindBox, compiler v0.8.19+commit.7dd6d404, optimizer on, 1 run. The SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode string is af3a27c36c19ca0b0c527a2ca24f930e0f670cae9ba1f1bc71a387cfecbc0db1. In contracts/BlindBoxV2.sol, _trySettle uses cachedBlockHash[target], else blockhash(target), else keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.prevrandao, betId, block.timestamp)). Parity is uint256(hash) % 16, and a win pays 195/100 of the stake through IATMToken.internalTransferFrom(DEAD, user, payout). settle(uint256) and batchSettle are unrestricted.

Reviewed loss. eth_getLogs on ATM 0x9c86f45905868317bacb8f442653d5e9a6888888, topic0 Transfer 0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef, blocks 87513684..87532383. dEaD to helper: 281 logs, 123773526.24365625 ATM, first block 87515760, last 0x68eedc7a52c4fb165350759d5213bc95a106cc55316e65487f4b4e2f2c718ce8 at block 87530623. Helper to dEaD: 339 logs, 65814212.64365625 ATM. Net 57959313.6 ATM. Split at the anchor block 87517587: before it, 139 logs pay 3528616.1625 and 259 stake 2409664.75 (net 1118951.4125, excluded as not fallback-driven); from the anchor on, 142 logs pay 120244910.08115625 and 80 stake 63404547.89365625, net 56840362.1875. These amounts match the BetPlaced/BetSettled amounts for user 0x9c18..2eea. Disposal: the helper's nine BSC-USD-receiving txs, 0x9c02fa6033b0895ea3329a26cbb46058bda24336b545739d676847692b0dd7cb (block 87525414) through 0x9de1f936ce382e053784e7fc7211f40a9e6ed6eba2a8fa8f3a5b085904c02020 (block 87532383, timestamp 1773938117), each borrow and repay about 8.88M BSC-USD from 0x8f73b65b4caaf64fba2af91cc5d4a2a1318e5d8c inside the tx. Receipts give Pancake V2 pair 0x4394f228cd29db11825a22b12cf132567e07eaa4 (token0 BSC-USD 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955, token1 ATM, factory 0xca143ce32fe78f1f7019d7d551a6402fc5350c73) receiving 58064313.6 ATM for a net BSC-USD outflow of 98309.438441108095465392. Every unit goes on to the attacker EOA. ATM balanceOf(helper) is 0 at block 87532383. 58064313.6 = 57959313.6 net winnings + 105000 ATM the EOA bought for 1500 BSC-USD (0x78ab7f1da74695602948dc83952debeb45de9250fb8fb1ebc67f49e79864a9b3) and sent to the helper. Unit value 98309.438441108095465392 / 58064313.6 = 0.0016931129009524379 USD per ATM. Loss = 56840362.1875 x that rate.
